title: Sources: the NSA has been testing Anthropic's Mythos model to find vulnerabilities in Microsoft products and widely used software from other companies (Jake Bleiberg/Bloomberg)
summary: Jake Bleiberg / Bloomberg: Sources: the NSA has been testing Anthropic's Mythos model to find vulnerabilities in Microsoft products and widely used software from other companies — The National Security Agency has been testing the capabilities of Anthropic PBC's new artificial intelligence model to find cybersecurity vulnerabilities …
